paragraphs.text: Kallisto Cloud's work bridging infrastructure scale with reliable operations sits at an essential intersection. What makes this Operations & Process Analyst role compelling to me is the opportunity to replace fragmented handoffs with structured, automated operating workflows.

Over the past 5 years in Berlin, I have focused on translating operational friction into measurable workflow improvements. At Horizon Global, I helped map cross-regional processes using BPMN and implemented n8n routing automations that reduced ticket escalation turnaround times by 65%.

This operational background aligns closely with Kallisto Cloud's current needs: maintaining reliable steering cadences, documenting standard procedures across cross-functional teams, and integrating source systems through clean webhooks and API scripting.

In this role, I would deliver a disciplined operating rhythm from day one: documenting As-Is workflows with precision, identifying operational bottlenecks before they impact customer SLAs, and delivering pragmatic automation prototypes.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background in business process mapping, documentation governance, and workflow automation can support Kallisto Cloud's objectives.
